python -c "
import subprocess, time, os, sys
log_path = r'E:/MemOmics-Agent/results/memomics-1c1890da/08_tile_diff.log'
monitor_path = r'E:/MemOmics-Agent/results/memomics-1c1890da/monitor_phase4_v2.log'
out_dir = r'E:/专利/ArchR_Output'

while True:
    time.sleep(120)  # 2 min interval
    try:
        # Read last 3 lines of log
        with open(log_path, 'r') as f:
            lines = f.readlines()
            last_lines = ''.join(lines[-3:]).strip()
        log_size = os.path.getsize(log_path) if os.path.exists(log_path) else 0
        
        # Check for new RDS files
        rds_files = [f for f in os.listdir(out_dir) if f.endswith('.rds')] if os.path.exists(out_dir) else []
        
        ts = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
        with open(monitor_path, 'a') as mf:
            mf.write(f'[{ts}] log:{log_size}B lines={len(lines)} rds={rds_files} tail:{last_lines}\n')
    except Exception as e:
        with open(monitor_path, 'a') as mf:
            mf.write(f'[{time.strftime(\"%H:%M:%S\")}] ERROR: {e}\n')
" &
